item.name: Creates an externally processed invoice in Appzen with optional validation checks

request.name: Creates an externally processed invoice in Appzen with optional validation checks

description.content: This will create a new invoice in AppZen referred by uuid. This invoice will be processed further by AppZen for extraction and validation (optionally, based on header input). When there already exists an invoice (invoice_id), then the operation is an update (the `status` would be `UPDATED` in this case).

header.description: Flag to indicate whether the invoice is historical or not
